selection.why_this_seed: backup pair; same caveats as run_map_pair.json

header_scale_bar.scale: 10 m = 0.688 in, same as the map panels

how_drawn.background: hillshade (az 315, alt 40, vert. exag. 3.0) of the scenario heightmap smoothed by 0.15 m, tinted by material (gravel trail = beige band); 0.25 m contours of the landform (heightmap + trench excavation, smoothed)
how_drawn.trench: GT ditch mask from metagross.sim.hazards.gt_hazard_raster (cells excavated > 0.05 m)
how_drawn.objects: static footprints from metagross.sim.objects.parse_static_objects; dark = protrudes above ground clearance (lethal), light = drive-over; true radius with a drawing floor of 0.3/0.18 m
how_drawn.paths: GT body-origin x, y from gt/states.npz (0.04 s physics steps)
how_drawn.end markers: last GT state; green dot = reached B, red X = referee terminal event (drawn unclipped so an exit at the frame stays whole)
how_drawn.confirmation marker: navy diamond = GT vehicle position at the confirmation tick
how_drawn.labels: placed by an occupancy check (objects, paths, trench, crest, markers, earlier labels); tick labels are dropped when every candidate overlaps something
